test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations launched the Bharatpol platform to enhance coordination with Interpol in January 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** is India's premier investigative agency responsible for handling complex cases related to corruption, financial crimes, and serious offenses.
 
• The **CBI** launched the **Bharatpol platform** to enhance coordination with **Interpol**, aiming to strengthen global crime-solving efforts.
 
• The platform facilitates seamless interaction between Indian law enforcement agencies and **Interpol**, improving international cooperation.
 
• It aligns with India's commitment to combating organized crime, terrorism, and cyber-related offenses globally.
 
• The **CBI** acts as the nodal agency for **Interpol** in India, handling matters related to international crime investigations.
 
• By launching Bharatpol, the agency aims to integrate advanced technologies and platforms for quicker response and better coordination in criminal investigations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Crime Records Bureau (NCR__B)**

 __
 
• The **NCRB** is responsible for collecting and analyzing crime data in India.
 
• It publishes the annual **Crime in India** report, which provides statistics and trends on crime across the country.
 
• The bureau also manages the **Crime and Criminal Tracking Network Systems (CCTNS)**, aimed at modernizing police forces.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)**__
 __
 
• The **MHA** oversees internal security, police administration, and disaster management in India.
 
• It is responsible for maintaining law and order within the country and coordinating with state governments on related matters.
 
• Although the **MHA** supervises the CBI, the bureau operates autonomously on legal matters.
 
 
 
• **National Investigation Agency (NIA)**__
 
 
• The **NIA** is India's counter-terrorism agency, established in 2008 after the Mumbai attacks.
 
• It is responsible for investigating and prosecuting offenses related to terrorism and national security.
 
• Unlike the **CBI**, the **NIA** primarily deals with crimes impacting national integrity and security.
